Card Q&A.a: Yes. Option card effects are effects just like any other, so you can't use them to play Digimon.
Card Q&A.q: Does this card's effect also prevent me from using Option card effects to play Digimon?

Card Q&A.a: Yes. Effects that only reduce play costs can still be activated. Effects that reduce play costs AND play Digimon can’t be activated.
Card Q&A.q: If this Digimon is in play, can I activate effects that reduce play costs?
Can players play Digimon into the breeding area by effects while this card is in the battle area?

Effect: [All Turns] Players can’t play Digimon by effects.
